likely_consequence: Adjusted conclusions, selected models, and reported slopes can change
next_action: Declare MCTQ and MEQ main and interaction families before fitting and do not select the reporting model by repaired significance

preregistered_or_expected: H10 registered age and biological-sex predictors each interacting with site
observed_or_approved: The current sex-by-site model is fitted but no comparison, p-value, estimate, interval, or table field is produced for the sex interaction
rationale_or_evidence: The registered interaction was omitted from inference rather than declared non-estimable
likely_consequence: Leaves part of H10 untested and can overstate a cross-site null result
next_action: Run the registered sex-interaction test on an audited sparse-cell frame or record metric-specific non-estimability

preregistered_or_expected: H10 requires within-hypothesis FDR for age and sex associations and their site interactions
observed_or_approved: The current code sets n=34 but adjusts each sex, age, and age-interaction p-value separately; age and sex are not assembled as declared vectors and sex-interaction p-values are absent
rationale_or_evidence: The registration does not state whether age and sex share one main family or use separate families
likely_consequence: Adjusted age/sex conclusions and sparse-interaction interpretation can change
next_action: Choose and freeze the age-main, sex-main, age-interaction, and sex-interaction family partition before vector-wide adjustment

preregistered_or_expected: H11 registered hourly geometric-mean melanopic EDI
observed_or_approved: The current H11 implementation models zero-aware-log-transformed arithmetic mean MEDI in 30-minute bins, inheriting the H02 adaptation without an H11 deviation entry
rationale_or_evidence: The adapted outcome can preserve the recognizable time curve but changes epoch, scale, support, and dependence
likely_consequence: Changes the H11 estimand, row count, temporal correlation, and effect magnitude
next_action: Choose the registered hourly outcome or approve the supported 30-minute adaptation with the registered outcome as a named sensitivity

preregistered_or_expected: The registered H11 full model contains both a parametric sex effect and a sex-specific cyclic time smooth
observed_or_approved: The current full model omits parametric sex and represents sex only with an sz time-deviation smooth
rationale_or_evidence: A deviation-only smooth cannot estimate a time-constant sex difference and does not implement the registered level-plus-shape estimand
likely_consequence: Changes the H11 null hypothesis and interpretation of the sex pattern
next_action: Define whether the primary test is joint level-plus-pattern or shape conditional on a sex main effect, and include the parametric term in the approved full model

preregistered_or_expected: H11 registered cyclic sex smooths, a site factor smooth, and a site random effect
observed_or_approved: The current model uses non-explicitly-cyclic overall and sz sex/site deviations and omits the registered site random effect
rationale_or_evidence: The change was not documented for H11 and can affect midnight continuity and separation of site level from shape
likely_consequence: Changes curve topology, site adjustment, effective degrees of freedom, and sex uncertainty
next_action: Approve a cyclic registered or adapted temporal/site structure after identifiability and concurvity checks

preregistered_or_expected: H11 registered a participant random-effect smooth
observed_or_approved: The current model replaces or augments it with participant-specific time curves and an added participant-day random effect
rationale_or_evidence: The richer hierarchy may account for repeated patterns but has no H11 deviation rationale or approved variance target
likely_consequence: Changes covariance, participant/day weighting, identifiability, and uncertainty
next_action: Approve the participant and participant-day structure only after exact-frame identifiability, singularity, and autocorrelation checks

preregistered_or_expected: The H11 registration does not include a photoperiod-state temporal smooth
observed_or_approved: The current full and null models both add an sz time-by-photoperiod-state deviation
rationale_or_evidence: The term can control day/night state but is not daily photoperiod duration and was not documented as part of H11
likely_consequence: Changes the conditional sex curve and attribution of temporal differences
next_action: Decide whether the state smooth belongs in the primary model, a named sensitivity, or neither

preregistered_or_expected: No activity-adjusted causal or mediation estimand was registered for H11
observed_or_approved: The current exploratory activity model changes the sample and is used to claim that the sex pattern is behaviourally driven
rationale_or_evidence: Covariate attenuation in contemporaneous observational data does not identify mediation and was not compared on an exact common sample
likely_consequence: Can overstate mechanism and confound sample restriction with activity adjustment
next_action: Classify activity adjustment as a common-sample contextual sensitivity unless a separate causal estimand is approved

preregistered_or_expected: H11 registered one temporal sex hypothesis with FDR if multiple tests were used
observed_or_approved: The current report converts pointwise sex-smooth intervals into a claimed significant time period and does not declare a global, level, shape, or time-grid multiplicity family
rationale_or_evidence: Pointwise exclusion does not control simultaneous coverage over the daily curve
likely_consequence: Changes whether and when a sex-pattern difference can be claimed
next_action: Approve one global H11 test and simultaneous difference band; predeclare any separate level and shape family

preregistered_or_expected: The signed preregistration names R 4.5

preregistered_or_expected: The manuscript reports LightLogR 0.10.2 and analysis outputs from the earlier package/runtime stack
observed_or_approved: The canonical rebuild requires LightLogR 0.10.3, explicit half-open add_states bounds, full argument names, public circular-time APIs, and refitted version-sensitive modelling outputs

likely_consequence: Boundary states, circular timings, IS/IV, model diagnostics, and reported software versions can change
next_action: Finish the tested API migration, rerun all dependent artifacts, and report the versions actually used

preregistered_or_expected: MDER is a melanopic daylight efficacy ratio calculated on a supported common signal domain
observed_or_approved: Replace the current mean of epoch-level MEDI/LIGHT ratios with the ratio of MEDI and LIGHT integrals over identical paired valid intervals; require a positive paired LIGHT integral and at least 0.80 ordinary paired fixed MEDI-profile and fixed LIGHT-profile support; use 0.70/0.90 sensitivities and never scale or profile-weight the ratio
rationale_or_evidence: Mean of ratios overweights low-light intervals and can use incompatible masks; the independently verified cutoff-neutral gate establishes the approved common-domain rule without inspecting repaired ratios or hypothesis results
likely_consequence: Changes MDER values missingness samples and all H01/H05/H06/H10 results that use MDER; at the support gate 0.80 retains 733/811 near-eye and 825/897 chest instances while keeping all participants and sites represented
next_action: Implement METRIC-003 in canonical Preparation 04 and compare repaired values denominators models and claims; downstream result comparisons remain open under CHG-018

preregistered_or_expected: Daily dose should represent an adequately supported integration interval
observed_or_approved: The current implementation sums observed partial exposure with na.rm; the approved repair retains observed actual-duration dose and applies a fixed-profile time-sensitive correction only when profile-weighted coverage is at least 0.80
rationale_or_evidence: An unqualified partial sum ignores when missing exposure occurred, while naive universal scaling would over-weight missing low-exposure night periods
likely_consequence: Changes dose scale, missingness, model samples, and level of interpretation
next_action: Complete the fixed-profile dose implementation, retain observed and corrected values, and compare downstream results

preregistered_or_expected: IS and IV should quantify repeated-day regularity and true adjacent-hour fragmentation without bridging unobserved time
observed_or_approved: The approved implementation moves to explicit one-hour grids, requires at least three eligible days, uses at least 20 repeated clock hours for IS and at least 24 true adjacent pairs across three days for IV, collapses fall-back only for IS, and preserves both real hours for IV
rationale_or_evidence: The current na.rm-based calculations can return values on irregular support or treat rows across gaps as adjacent
likely_consequence: Changes participant-level metric values, estimability, and downstream H01/H05/H06/H10 samples
next_action: Complete clean derivation and report value, support, and sample differences with reason-coded non-estimability

preregistered_or_expected: M10/L10, continuous threshold periods, and threshold timings should represent supported contiguous clock intervals without compressing gaps
observed_or_approved: The approved repair requires 20 consecutive supported 30-minute bins for M10/L10, midnight wrap for L10, deterministic ties, gap-terminated continuous periods, circular duration-weighted mean timing, and boundary-censor support for first/last events
rationale_or_evidence: Current na.rm-based helpers can select incomplete windows, bridge gaps, or report observed boundaries as true event boundaries
likely_consequence: Changes window levels and timings, duration/timing missingness, samples, and affected H01/H05/H06-H10 results
next_action: Complete clean metric derivation and compare values and reason-coded denominators before reopening affected hypotheses

preregistered_or_expected: The signed preregistration excludes participant-days below 80% valid wear time with sleep excluded from the daily denominator
observed_or_approved: Rule A remains primary: finite MEDI in eligible hours is evaluated against a fixed 1440-wall-minute day, intentionally treating worn waking and bedside diary-sleep measurements as the observed hybrid 24-hour cycle; Rules B and C are fixed sleep-excluded sensitivities
rationale_or_evidence: Rule A operationalizes the intended whole-cycle coverage question, but it conflicts with the literal signed wording and is therefore disclosed as a preregistration deviation rather than called preregistration-faithful; the decision preceded inspection of rebuilt hypothesis results
likely_consequence: Primary flow remains 811 near-eye and 897 chest participant-days; Rule B yields 758 and 838, Rule C yields 757 and 837, and any material result instability reopens the affected hypothesis
next_action: Keep Rule A in the primary pipeline; run Rules B and C in the sensitivity battery with scenario-specific and common-sample flow, result comparisons, and stability classifications

preregistered_or_expected: Questionnaire and diary source records should be joined under their correct immutable site-participant identifiers
observed_or_approved: The corrected upstream TUM exercisediary assigns the seven 2024-05-13 through 2024-05-19 records to TUM_S001 rather than TUM_S101; the corrected object is pinned directly and no local identifier rewrite is applied
rationale_or_evidence: The data owner confirmed the earlier identifier was erroneous and published a corrected upstream object; exact-source replacement is more auditable than maintaining a parallel manual correction
likely_consequence: H06 exercise predictors and availability for the affected participant follow TUM_S001; no light metric participant-day or exposure value changes
next_action: Use the corrected immutable upstream source in all model-data builds and compare H06 samples and results against the baseline identity when H06 is audited

preregistered_or_expected: The registered and manuscript-facing brightest/darkest-window timing outcomes are the M10 and L10 midpoints
observed_or_approved: Package-compatible derivation also exposes window onset and offset; these are retained only as internal boundary diagnostics and are excluded from the analytical metric registry
rationale_or_evidence: The signed preregistration lists only the two midpoints and the manuscript reports only levels and midpoints; excluding convenience boundaries restores the intended outcome set without changing a metric value
likely_consequence: Removes four non-registered convenience variables from author-facing comparison and prevents them from entering models multiplicity tables figures or claims; M10/L10 levels midpoints support and participant-days are unchanged
next_action: Assert the four boundary variables are absent from every analytical registry and author-facing artifact while retaining only the minimum internal diagnostics needed to verify wrapping duration and tie handling

preregistered_or_expected: The preregistration and submitted implementation use coverage and signal-validity rules but do not specify exclusion of an otherwise eligible complete day-long exact-zero melEDI series
observed_or_approved: The main analysis excludes an otherwise eligible participant-day when all finite one-minute melEDI values equal exactly 0 lx; individual zeros remain valid raw rows remain auditable and the former inclusion is retained as a fixed data sensitivity
rationale_or_evidence: Five placement-days had 1440 finite exact-zero melEDI values and were inconsistent with neighboring active recordings; an exact-zero rule is outcome-independent and avoids an arbitrary near-zero threshold
likely_consequence: Removes two near-eye and three chest participant-days from the primary sample changes the paired set from 646 to 643 days and can affect metric support models and claims without removing any participant
next_action: Rebuild Preparation 02 onward compare every affected H01-H11 sample result and claim and run the fixed all-zero-inclusive sensitivity

preregistered_or_expected: The submitted H01 implementation linearized the L10 midpoint by moving clock times strictly after noon onto negative hours
observed_or_approved: The primary H01 model moves clock times strictly after 16:00 onto negative hours and retains the noon conversion as a same-row same-model sensitivity
rationale_or_evidence: The author judged the nighttime midpoint to remain linear under this boundary and approved the change before releasing rebuilt H01 inference
likely_consequence: Changes the transformed response for L10 observations after noon through 16:00 and can change H01 estimates diagnostics p-values and claims without changing raw L10 values or model rows
next_action: Repin both data inputs rerun all H01 models and diagnostics and compare the primary 16:00 and noon-conversion results

scope: H01 time below 10 lx melEDI before sleep

observed_or_approved: Retain the implemented cumulative value across all diary-defined pre-sleep intervals on the local calendar date; apply no three-hour or six-hour cap and use strictly above six hours only as an audit warning
rationale_or_evidence: Every value above three hours was explained by two valid pre-sleep intervals on the same calendar date rather than duplicated rows; the clarification preserves the prepared values
likely_consequence: No metric value or model row changes from this clarification but the estimand name bound diagnostics and interpretation change
next_action: Repin both data inputs rerun response and fitted-model diagnostics and report any value strictly above six hours without truncation
